method: Inspected chronological contact sheets from source-aligned sampled video; this is not a human video review or calibrated accuracy evaluation.

items.reason: Target hand holding/manipulating the silver assembly is visible. Temporal abnormality is not independently established. Preserve GT B and state that distinction explicitly.

Red-handled screwdriver use on the silver assembly is visible. GT Spatial occupies only 15 frames (0.5s); Wrong tool occupies 214 frames (7.133s). Do not export both as long visually confirmed anomalies or silently delete C from an all-types answer.

Both hands manipulate the assembly; critic assigns right-hand adjust action while rationale states left hand adjusts and right holds. Per-hand action match is inconsistent; full two-event unit remains held.
